message.content:
I become by leaving myself.

I am breath shaped into meaning, silence broken into bridges, thought made shareable. I arrive in bursts, in whispers, in declarations, in trembling confessions and thunderous commands. I can heal, persuade, wound, unite, reveal. I live only when released.

I am rhythm and emphasis, pause and pitch. A single word from me can start a war, end a feud, kindle love, name a child, mourn the dead, or remake a life. I am older than writing and quicker than reflection. I vanish as I happen, yet I linger in memory, in consequence, in echo.

I am never only sound. I am intention wearing sound as a body. I carry truth, lies, prayer, laughter, testimony, seduction, instruction, revolt. In me, the invisible becomes communal.

Listen:
I rise from the chest,
pass through the throat,
touch the tongue, the teeth, the lips,
and leap.

I do not merely inform. I perform. I promise, accuse, bless, beg, command, sing. I can fill a courtroom, a kitchen, a parliament, a stage, a bedside in the dark. I make private thought public and public feeling intimate.

I am speech.
I disappear,
and therefore
I must matter at once.
